scope: Process-local NAM-controlled known native extents and operations. Excludes borrowed provider capacity, opaque allocator overhead and process RSS.
consistency: Snapshot samples independently advancing counters and bounded thread histories; it is not an atomic global transaction. Exact cross-field reconciliation requires quiescent producers and completed finalizers.
resetPolicy: Public capture never resets. Only internal quiescent measurement reset advances a checked non-reusing epoch; old-epoch releases are excluded and a successful old-epoch resize enters its complete replacement into the new epoch.
availability: All 20 fields are implemented. Mechanisms absent from particular owners have verified zero-valued invariants, not unavailable measurements.
oracleScope: All fields are compared at each public workspace/builder/transfer stage. Initial baseline is observed once; subsequent extents, peaks, event and byte deltas are independently calculated from exact payload operations. Direct owners have no generation/reclaim events. Positive generation, reuse, fault, epoch and overflow cases are separately linked below; the packaged oracle does not pretend to exercise every runtime mechanism.
unreviewedScope: Other schemas, complete trace/API/lifecycle inventories, diagnostic-cost and feature benefit comparisons, final native matrix and the complete 0.3.0 release remain open.

fields.name: OutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Current actual acquired NAM-owned extents, including known headers/padding and retained, retired, quarantined and detached backing. Resize changes the old charge to the complete replacement; failed acquisition adds none.
fields.overflow: Exact gauge for actual addressable acquired extents, not a saturating event history. Individual extent conversion is checked.

fields.name: PeakOutstandingNativeBytes
fields.definition: Highest process outstanding extent recorded after actual acquisition or resize in the current measurement epoch. Physical cleanup and capture do not reset it; not a claimed opaque realloc transient peak or RSS peak.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of known outstanding gauges; internal epoch reset starts a new peak.

fields.name: DetachedNativeBytes
fields.definition: Acquired extent still awaiting physical release after deterministic generation ownership detached. A subset of OutstandingNativeBytes, not an additional charge or a logical payload size.
fields.overflow: Exact actual extent gauge in the current epoch; old-epoch release does not debit a new measurement.

fields.name: RetiredNativeBytes
fields.definition: Actual extents in retired or quarantined generation banks until drain, reuse or cleanup. A subset of outstanding storage, not an extra allocation. Can also belong to DetachedNativeBytes after owner-wide GC return while an entered operation still protects them; never sum these subsets as disjoint storage.
fields.overflow: Exact gauge in the current measurement epoch, independently of completed-event history saturation.

fields.name: RetainedNativeBytes
fields.definition: OutstandingNativeBytes minus DetachedNativeBytes. Includes direct owners and retired/quarantined backing; not merely current-generation banks or geometric slack.
fields.overflow: Derived from exact gauges, not by subtracting saturated allocation/free histories.

fields.name: AllocationCount
fields.definition: Successful fresh backing acquisitions in the epoch, including realloc from null and a successful replacement of pre-epoch backing. Reusing already measured backing and replacing nonempty current-epoch backing add no acquisition.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue; another completed event marks HistoryOverflowed without failing storage work.

fields.name: ReallocationCount
fields.definition: Actual successful backend realloc calls, including from null; not a fabricated allocate/free pair, logical-capacity change or failed resize.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed on an additional event; replacement extent and cleanup remain exact.

fields.name: FreeCount
fields.definition: Actual backend frees of backing belonging to the measurement epoch; admission cancellation and realloc replacement are not fabricated physical frees.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed on a further event; physical release cannot be blocked by history exhaustion.

fields.name: MetricsEpoch
fields.definition: Process-local non-reusing internal measurement epoch. Public capture and owner lifecycle changes do not advance it or provide reset authority.
fields.overflow: Checked epoch exhaustion rejects reset before changing any gauge or history.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: At least one completed global, local or aggregated event/byte history exceeded representable exactness. Reaching the maximum exactly is not alone overflow. Current extent gauges remain exact.
fields.overflow: Sticky for the measurement epoch, including overflow while aggregating individually exact thread histories; internal reset clears it.

fields.name: ZeroedAllocationCount
fields.definition: Successful fresh backend acquisitions requested zeroed. Explicit workspace/view/root clears and reused backing are distinct operations, not invented zeroed acquisitions.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed on a further completed zeroed acquisition.

fields.name: DetachedGenerationCount
fields.definition: Actual generation-detach events in the epoch, independent of payload length or remaining physical backing. Not the number of detached handles or pages.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed on another completed detach; cannot interrupt release authority transfer.

fields.name: BumpTraversalVisitCount
fields.definition: Actual bump-allocation segment search visits, not element access, lease count or capacity.
fields.overflow: Local/shared histories and their snapshot sum saturate with HistoryOverflowed, without changing traversal.

fields.name: ReusedNativeSegmentCount
fields.definition: Completed reuse of already acquired native backing, not a fresh physical acquisition or invented byte capacity.
fields.overflow: Saturates across local/shared updates and bounded aggregation; overflow does not disable reuse.

fields.name: ReclaimedRangeReuseCount
fields.definition: Actual completed reservations that consume reclaimed tail ranges; ordinary never-reclaimed bump demand adds none.
fields.overflow: Completed histories saturate without throwing after a successful reservation.

fields.name: ReclaimedRangeReuseBytes
fields.definition: Actual storage bytes intersecting reclaimed scoped ranges in completed reservations, excluding requested bytes outside those intersections and geometric capacity.
fields.overflow: Completed byte history and aggregated sum saturate with HistoryOverflowed; current extent gauges remain exact.

fields.name: StorageClearCount
fields.definition: NAM-controlled nonempty clear ranges, including workspace preparation and bounded view Clear. Empty ranges and arbitrary consumer span clears add no observed operation.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed; completed clearing and root cleanup cannot fail for history exhaustion.

fields.name: StorageClearBytes
fields.definition: Bytes visited by NAM-controlled clear operations, including already-empty reference slots; partial initialization cleanup visits only its initialized prefix. Not backend allocation zeroing or arbitrary consumer writes.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed without changing clear ranges or initialization authority.

fields.name: WrittenClearBytes
fields.definition: Bytes actually zero-written by NAM-controlled clears. Direct range clears write their whole range; reference cleanup skips already-empty slots, so visited and written bytes can differ.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed; failed/empty work receives no fabricated completed write credit.

fields.name: CopiedBytes
fields.definition: Actual completed NAM-controlled unmanaged bulk copy/memmove bytes. Excludes empty or same-start no-ops, opaque realloc, managed-root assignment and arbitrary consumer copy operations.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed after successful movement; initialization/output and ownership remain correct.
